text.p: Northland Cranberries Inc, the world's largest cranberry grower, said Wednesday it appointed Jerold Kaminski to the positions of president and chief operating officer.
Kaminski has been corporate vice president and director of marketing for the Gold Medal division of General Mills Inc .
John Swendrowski will remain chairman of the board and chief executive officer of North Cranberries, the company said in a statement.

The company said its juice product line is approaching national distribution and the company must now turn to implementing a comprehensive marketing plan over the long term. "Kaminski has the depth of experience and demonstrated expertise in the marketing of consumer food products to guide our efforts in the branded juice arena, as well as to oversee our entry into the private label juice products market," said Swendrowski.
Kaminski had been a member of Northland Cranberries' board for the past three years.
Shares of Northland Cranberries were trading up 1-3/4 to 14-3/4.
